rows.corpus_definition: When a machine stops working or a situation fails.

rows.corpus_definition: A very light and pleasant wind.

rows.corpus_definition: To send out programs via television or radio waves.

rows.corpus_definition: Sending signals through the air to televisions or radios.

rows.corpus_definition: the amount of money you have to spend

rows.corpus_definition: a short official notice giving news or new information

rows.corpus_definition: Several things held or tied together.

rows.corpus_definition: To break open suddenly because there is too much inside.

rows.corpus_definition: Without planning or intending to do something.

rows.corpus_definition: To know something well enough to say it without looking at text.
